packageRules.description: Subject prefix for the local toolchain: mise.toml, composer-pinned tools and Go modules. Kernel style, 'subsystem: short description', because these are commits on main like any other.
Subject prefix for the workflows' action pins and the Renovate image itself.
Subject prefix for a repository's image build inputs, wherever a Containerfile or Dockerfile appears. Kernel style, 'subsystem: short description', because these are commits on main like any other.

ci's pin check refuses a repository whose divbast/ci refs name more than one SHA, and a repository calls several reusable workflows on several lines. Every ref therefore has to move in one commit, so they share one group and one PR.
A new major of divbast/ci means a breaking change to a reusable workflow's inputs, so a person approves it from the Dependency Dashboard. Minor and patch releases keep automerging.

jq tags releases as jq-1.8.2. mise strips that prefix from aqua's registry entry; Renovate does not read the aqua registry, so without this every candidate version is discarded as unparseable and no PR is ever raised.

trivy is looked up on Docker Hub, not GitHub. The aquasecurity org has an IP allow list, and GitHub enforces it on API reads by an App installed on an organisation, as divbast-renovate is, so every github-tags or github-releases lookup is refused and the 403 surfaces only as no-result. mise still installs from the release download, which the allow list does not cover. aquasec/trivy is pushed by the same GoReleaser run that publishes those binaries, tagged with the same bare version. Docker versioning keeps latest, canary and the older per-architecture tags such as 0.71.2-amd64 out of the candidates.

The go line in go.mod is a language version, not a library. Raising it can enable newer vet checks, which ride on the go line and can fail a build that passed before, so a person approves it from the Dependency Dashboard.

github.com/divbast/ci reaches each repository through a replace to a local .ci/ checkout that the workflow refs pin, so the go.mod version is a placeholder. The github-actions digest on those refs is the one dependency that moves it, and a gomod PR would only churn the placeholder.
